import math
import unittest

from solution import DiscreteStateModel


class DiscreteStateModelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_model(self):
        return DiscreteStateModel(
            ["hot", "cold"],
            ["x", "y"],
            [[0.7, 0.3], [0.4, 0.6]],
            [[0.5, 0.5], [0.1, 0.9]],
            [0.6, 0.4],
        )

    def test_forward_and_backward_known_likelihood(self):
        model = self.make_model()
        observations = ["x", "y"]
        original = observations[:]
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.forward(observations), 0.2156, places=12)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.backward(iter(observations)), 0.2156, places=12)
        self.assertEqual(observations, original)

    def test_empty_and_single_observation(self):
        model = self.make_model()
        self.assertEqual(model.forward([]), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(model.backward(()), 1.0)
        expected = 0.6 * 0.5 + 0.4 * 0.1
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.forward(["x"]), expected)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.backward(["x"]), expected)

    def test_constructor_deep_copies_inputs(self):
        states = ["s0", "s1"]
        symbols = ["a", "b"]
        transition = [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]]
        emission = [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]]
        initial = [1.0, 0.0]
        model = DiscreteStateModel(states, symbols, transition, emission, initial)

        states[0] = "changed"
        symbols[0] = "changed"
        transition[0][0] = 0.0
        emission[0][0] = 0.0
        initial[0] = 0.0
        self.assertEqual(model.forward(["a", "a"]), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(model.backward(["a", "a"]), 1.0)

    def test_unknown_symbol(self):
        model = self.make_model()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            model.forward(["x", "unknown"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            model.backward(["unknown"])

    def test_invalid_state_and_symbol_sequences(self):
        cases = [
            ([], ["x"]),
            (["a", "a"], ["x"]),
            ([[]], ["x"]),
            (["a"], []),
            (["a"], ["x", "x"]),
            (["a"], [[]]),
        ]
        for states, symbols in cases:
            with self.subTest(states=states, symbols=symbols):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    DiscreteStateModel(states, symbols, [[1.0]], [[1.0]], [1.0])

    def test_shape_probability_and_type_validation(self):
        invalid_cases = [
            ([[1.0]], [[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [0.5, 0.5]),
            ([[1.0, 0.0]], [[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [0.5, 0.5]),
            ([[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [[1.0], [1.0]], [0.5, 0.5]),
            ([[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [1.0]),
            ([[0.6, 0.6], [0.5, 0.5]], [[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [0.5, 0.5]),
            ([[-0.1, 1.1], [0.5, 0.5]], [[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [0.5, 0.5]),
            ([[math.inf, 0.0], [0.5, 0.5]], [[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [0.5, 0.5]),
            ([[True, 0.0], [0.5, 0.5]], [[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [0.5, 0.5]),
            ([[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]], [[0.5, "bad"], [0.5, 0.5]], [0.5, 0.5]),
        ]
        for transition, emission, initial in invalid_cases:
            with self.subTest(transition=transition, emission=emission, initial=initial):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    DiscreteStateModel(["a", "b"], ["x", "y"], transition, emission, initial)

    def test_sum_tolerance_boundary(self):
        model = DiscreteStateModel(
            ["s"], ["x"], [[1.0 + 5e-10]], [[1.0 - 5e-10]], [1.0]
        )
        self.assertTrue(math.isfinite(model.forward(["x"])))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            DiscreteStateModel(["s"], ["x"], [[1.0 + 2e-9]], [[1.0]], [1.0])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
